title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. Every position here is paper, and 1 trade says nothing about a strategy. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-06T14:36:24.907Z.

## What the engines show as open

The open section reads as a flat book: htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper, trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper, and trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper. That is the current state of the running record, not a claim about future activity. The record also lists a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since. The engine tallies and the NEAR item are both part of the same paper record, so they are reported together without being merged into a single position count. The 0 open positions on the engines and the open NEAR entry are separate readings from the same running record.

## Closed trades and recent exits

Closed-trade averages are negative where an average is given. htf-rsi-v007 has closed 4 trades so far, with average null net per trade, so the record does not state a percentage average for those 4 closed trades. trend-daily-v005 has closed 6 trades so far, with average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has closed 7 trades so far, with average -13.34% net per trade.

The initial live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The ATOM position exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The exit rule was the 10-day low, the measurement was the close at 1.703, and the resulting recorded net outcome was −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The ATOM entry at 2.066 and exit at 1.703 are the only price levels given for that trade in this record.

The most recent exits are UNIUSDT on 2026-11-06, at -10.91% net, closed on regime, and HYPEUSDT on 2026-11-06, at -14.08% net, closed on breakdown. These are recorded outcomes with recorded reasons. They do not imply that the next trade will produce a similar result, and they do not turn a recorded loss into a claim about future profits.

## Market filter and distance to breakout

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. The record presents that state as a current reading. It does not state that the filter will turn on, that an entry will follow, or that a candidate will be skipped. The filter being off and the 0 open positions are separate readings; the record does not say that the filter caused the exits or that the exits caused the filter state.

Both engines list the same nearest distances to a 20-day breakout. ZECUSDT is 2.63% below its high. BCHUSDT is 8.00% below its high. BNBUSDT is 9.23% below its high. These distances are measurements from the running record. They describe how far each symbol is from its 20-day breakout level at the snapshot time. They are not price targets and they are not entry instructions.

## Live starts, expectation, and where to check

v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026. v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. The initial live signal, the ATOM entry at 2.066, came after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The two trend engines therefore do not have the same amount of live history in this snapshot.

In testing, losses were more common than wins and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The ATOM result of −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip is 1 recorded loss inside that expectation. It is not proof of future performance, and it is not a verdict on either engine.

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The record updates continuously, so the figures above are the state at 2026-11-06T14:36:24.907Z.
